text_block_list.text: One bright, pleasant afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Look, look, Ryan-chan.
There's a poster here...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "'Deserted Island Project! Wild pioneers wanted, big, BIG time!'?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Sprint through the great outdoors, guided purely by instinct—! Let's build the ultimate training facility!"
Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing 'the strongest training facility' makes my biceps twitch with excitement~!
Ines, wanna go check it out with me?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Say what?! 'Participants get unlimited access to the
newly built training facility,
plus exquisite staff meals'?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Contact: 000-XXXX-YYYY!
Let's make these 3 years ignite our souls! *Chairwoman-approved"
—Building training facilities, huh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
An experience like this doesn't come along very often.
Besides, crafting something we use every day...
might actually teach us quite a lot, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, I *am* looking at it.
This definitely isn't a tropical vacation.
It says "Development and Construction" right here—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? You already signed up enough for all of us!?
Jordan, are you for real...!?
As I looked at the poster causing such a stir across the academy together with <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Does this pique your interest,
Trainer <username>?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! It concerns the URA, but
I was so moved by the project leader's passion
that I resolved to lend my full cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the 'person in charge' wants to rely on not just students,
but also the knowledge of the trainers.
If you're interested, please do join in!"
We figured it wouldn't hurt to just go for the first day. After deciding that with <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A deserted island!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So this is the famous "Tracsen Island," huh?
Nhaahaa! The fact that there's nothing here at all gets me so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the sea's crystal clear.
Is that coral over there?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me... Do you hear, like, beastly growls coming from the woods over there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This feels just like a school campout, I'm so hyped!
Hey, Ines! Let's go for a quick run!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Geez, what am I gonna do with you?
The briefing's about to start, so let's do it after!

And so, while waiting for the briefing session to start
alongside the Umamusume who seemed to be
participating in the project—
Yo yo yo!
Are you unleashing your instincts?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Unleashing instinct...? Wait, who the heck are you!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Dwahaha! I am Tucker Brine!
As I was wishing for the Umamusume to soar to even greater heights—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Through a whole stroke of luck,
I ended up launching this project!
I am both the project leader and site supervisor, baby!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you for all sorts of things from now on!
Nice to work with ya!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Now then—!
Right now, I am... overwhelmingly happy!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Pioneering against the great wilderness!
A construction plan that is a journey to find the right answers!
Meticulous, long-term construction work!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"To think so many of you Umamusume would gather
for the long journey that's about to begin~!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Of course! The specialized work is for specialists!
You guys just lend us a hand with your muscle power, your love for racing, and above all, your pure hearts!

Overwhelmed by her sheer momentum...
the briefing for the deserted island project began!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Now then! The goal of the "Deserted Island Project" is to build the ultimate cluster of training facilities!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
In other words, run through fields! Scale cliffs! Cross seas!
Train yourself alongside the pulse of great nature!
Bring out 120% of your physical potential!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "Now THAT is the ultimate training facility I've been dreaming of!"

text_block_list.name: PJ Participants
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I see, so basically...
'Placing a carrot on the mountain works too'... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Among these tasks, I ask you Umamusume to use your power
to assist with pioneering and construction! Furthermore,
I hope you will share the insights gained from your training!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, from time to time! I'll be asking for 'Island Training'—aka 'Island Workouts'!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"To put it simply, it's a trial run of our newly built training facility!
We'll use everything and see how it performs!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This island training can be conducted as development progresses.
For convenience, development progress will be represented
as "Development Points," but...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Tazuna-san will explain the details regarding Development Points later.
Don't rush, just wait patiently!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And—here is the most important part!
This project will hold an evaluation meeting
every six months!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: This evaluation directly impacts our support amount! Therefore, I want us to draft and execute construction plans continuously for this purpose!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "Each workflow step, schedules, et cetera! And among all of those, the most important thing is—"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's all about what we build!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
What can we build that will make the Umamusume stronger!?
What will serve as the bridge to their dreams!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I would love to hear thoughts from our Trainers!
Umamusume, please share your experiences and feelings!
I would greatly appreciate everyone's utmost efforts—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...What a blessing!!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Now then—lastly!
This project has a deadline of roughly 3 years!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"If we don't make this project a success,
the facility gets demolished! We don't have the funds
to keep running an unfinished project!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However, I have staked my life on this project!
I will not allow it to be demolished!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"To make that happen, your cooperation is vital!
Come on, clench those fists! Raise those arms!
Put your soul into it...!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Burn it uuuupーー!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
W-We gotta put our all into
participating in this, Ryan-chan!

At any rate, the briefing was over—
and we decided to explore the island
until it was time to head back!

(Ch... chirp chirp... screeech...
Whoosh, whoosh... grrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
D-Did I wander too far?
This island is way too huge...!
(GYAOOOOOH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, where is everybody!?
Where am I~!?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That mushroom is huuuuge!!
And so colorfulll!! Hey, someone look at this--!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so fast, so fast!
Way to go, Mr. Ostrich!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, that's incredible!
...Alright, I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. Ines-senpai and Ryan-senpai are
running over hereーー

text_block_list.name: Tamamo & Chiyo
text_block_list.text:
Look at this, City! It's a huge mushroom!
Ah, there you are, City-san! Thank goodness~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Chiyo and Tamamo-senpai too!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait, no way...!?
Why...!
(Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, City-chan!
My legs just wouldn't stop!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My bad! Thank goodness I dodged it in the nick of ti—
Huh?! Where'd my mushroom go?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
Ah, geez—!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That gave me a scare~! Ahahaha!

A deep forest, and a crystal-clear ocean.
The rustling of trees, and the cries of animals.
Untouched, magnificent nature—

In an environment vastly different from her usual one,
<chrname> seemed to be able
to relax a little bit.
choice_data_list: (Just that alone made participating worth it!)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer <username>!
I've heard about your success from the Chairwoman!
I'm counting on you! Let's do this!
choice_data_list: Mr. Tucker, the pleasure is mine!

text_block_list.text:
By the way, what kind of facility is she specifically trying to build?
When I asked her that—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
For instance,
"running alongside wild animals" or a "giant maze"!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy has top-of-the-line facilities!
That's exactly why this needs to be a place
that serves a purpose from a completely different angle!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Under harsher conditions, purposefully applying training loads that cannot be controlled!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Or unlocking brain sensors through unused muscles
and movements! Thinking of functional trainingâ

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Additionally, in order to make full use of the benefits gained from a relaxed body and mind, details can be found here on page 9—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...If you would, please... look with your eyes............

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: *Ahem!*

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So! In other words!
It means I've got a massive dream, baby!!

Either way, all the training regimens written
in the booklet she gave me were quite intriguing.
The pioneering itself involves assembling and carrying lumber and stone, which requires powerful physical exertion, and—

Above all, <chrname> seemed to really like that island.
Participating might serve as a nice breath of fresh air.
And so, I would continue taking part in the deserted island project together with <chrname>!
